name: web-mount-fuji-travel-hero-with-red-split-and-booking-bar
title: 'Discover Beautiful Mount Fuji' hero with red split background and floating booking search bar
whatItIs: A hero split into cream and crimson halves with a rounded photo of Mount Fuji and a pagoda, a centred white headline with underlined 'Mount Fuji', four checklist perks, a floating white search bar (From, To, Dates) with a red circle search button, and red striped circles and dot grids.
whatItMeans: Inviting and cultural; the red nods to Japan while the booking bar makes it actionable.
techniques: Split the background into two colours behind a photo.
Float a booking bar across the photo's bottom edge.
List perks as a checklist in the hero.

vocabulary.definition: A search form for trips with fields and a button.
Two colour blocks side by side.
